action.name: Extract here
action.command: wezterm start sh -c 'case "%f" in *.zip) unzip "%f" -d "${PWD}";; *.tar.gz|*.tgz) tar -xzf "%f" -C "${PWD}";; *.tar.bz2|*.tbz2) tar -xjf "%f" -C "${PWD}";; *.tar.xz) tar -xJf "%f" -C "${PWD}";; *.tar) tar -xf "%f" -C "${PWD}";; esac && echo "\nFinished! Press Enter to close" && read'

action.name: Compress to ZIP
action.command: wezterm start sh -c 'filename=$(basename "%f"); zip -r "${filename}.zip" "%f" && echo "\nFinished! Press Enter to close" && read'
action.description: Compress file or folder to ZIP
